phase: 1 - grooming and training end-to-end, driven in a real browser with demo data
title: The Training booking declared a payment capture it never obtained, and its own declaration is what suppressed the capture
method: Same browser journey, immediately after P1-02 unblocked the window check.
measured: POST /api/canonical-bookings -> 409 {"error":"Training quote requires server-confirmed sandbox capture before programme booking"}
The body it sent carried payment:{"status":"captured","detail":"Training UAT sandbox capture marker; live money disabled"}
No request to /api/training-payment-sandbox was made at any point in the journey.
the_server_was_right: lib/training-commercial-governance.ts requires a real attestation row (requireTrainingQuoteSandboxCapture) and will not take the client's word for it. That control held, and is untouched. The client is what was broken - and it was broken for every non-Meet-&-Greet Training booking a customer can make, so the journey could not complete at all.
root_cause: lib/training-booking-client.ts POSTed /api/canonical-bookings itself, with a hardcoded status:'captured' and a marker string it wrote, never passing through the attestation step.

lib/canonical-lifecycle-client.ts HAS that step, but gated it on `input.payment.status!=="captured"`. So any caller that pre-labels its own payment 'captured' silently skips the capture that label is supposed to stand for. The client's claim about itself decided whether the claim would be checked - the same 'unknown or self-asserted treated as satisfied' shape this audit has found repeatedly.
fix: lib/canonical-lifecycle-client.ts: the attestation gate no longer consults input.payment.status. What decides is what the booking IS - a governed Training programme with a server quote to capture against. attestTrainingProgramme is replay-safe: the capture key is memoised per quote and the server returns the same attestation for a repeat.

lib/training-booking-client.ts: now routes through createCanonicalLifecycle instead of its own fetch, so there is ONE booking path for Training and the attestation is on it. It sends status:'created'; the attestation is what promotes it.
meet_and_greet_left_alone: lib/training-commercial-governance.ts refuses to sandbox-capture a Meet & Greet quote at all and holds it pending a verified payment event. The client mirrors that by package code, which is the only signal it holds; the authority is the package table's meet_and_greet column, so a NEW Meet-&-Greet package code would need that line updated with it. Recorded rather than papered over.
regression: tests/ptja-p1-training-capture-attestation.test.mjs - 7 cases driving the real exported client functions with a stubbed fetch, asserting the request SEQUENCE

red_first.P1-C01: RED - only /api/canonical-bookings was called; no capture at all
red_first.P1-C02: RED - the booking carried the self-written marker, not a server reference
red_first.P1-C03: RED - a failing capture did not prevent the booking POST
red_first.P1-C05: RED - a caller declaring its own payment 'captured' skipped the capture

non_vacuity_controls_green_throughout: P1-C04 - Trainer Meet & Greet still books without attempting a capture
P1-C06 - a Training booking with no server quote is not sent to the capture endpoint
P1-C07 - grooming, boarding and pet_sitting never capture a Training quote

sabotage.control: restore the `input.payment.status!=="captured"` gate AND the hardcoded captured marker
sabotage.result: RED - P1-C01, P1-C02, P1-C03, P1-C05; controls GREEN

sabotage.control: bypass the lifecycle client entirely - direct POST to /api/canonical-bookings with status forced to captured
sabotage.result: RED - P1-C01, P1-C02, P1-C03; controls GREEN

verified_in_the_browser: Persisted booking_payments.detail_json: {"detail":"Server-attested Training UAT sandbox capture · TRN-UAT-PAY-D75CDCF9-514","liveMoney":false,...} - the server's own reference, not the fabricated marker
training_quote_payment_attestations row present: status captured, amount 3000, environment sandbox
environment_note: Reaching the capture at all required declaring PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV=sandbox in the gitignored local .dev.vars. Before that the endpoint refused with 'Training sandbox payment is disabled unless PAWSPACE_PAYMENT_ENV is explicitly set to sandbox' - the Wave-1 rule that an absent variable is not a declaration, working exactly as intended. No secret value was printed or committed and no deployed configuration was changed.
not_claimed: No live money moved and none can: this is the sandbox attestation path, liveMoney:false throughout. Live payment remains a launch dependency.
Only the Training vertical was driven this way. Boarding, Sitting and Grooming client paths have not been checked for the same self-declared-payment shape.

shadowed_test_found.case: Training customer booking consumes a server quote and records only UAT sandbox payment truth
shadowed_test_found.what: A source-text contract case that REQUIRED lib/training-booking-client.ts to contain `status:"captured"` and the literal "Training UAT sandbox capture marker". It required the client to declare a payment capture it had never obtained, and passed for exactly as long as that was true.
shadowed_test_found.why_it_could_not_catch_this: A source-text pin proves a string is present. It cannot tell whether the string is a fact. The behaviour it was standing in for - one server-quoted booking path, no live money - is now proven request-by-request in tests/ptja-p1-training-capture-attestation.test.mjs.
shadowed_test_found.how_it_was_updated: Retargeted at the path the client actually takes (createCanonicalLifecycle) and at the POSITIVE payload literal `status:"created"`. A negative substring ban was tried first and rejected: it tripped on the fix's own explanatory comment quoting the old string - the same weakness, one step removed.
